decisions.reason: Addressing the parent objection directly: while the surrounding PDF context indicates partly replicated findings (disconfirming the shipped 'failed' verdict that considers only the love/commitment Romeo and Juliet effect and ignores the replicated trust and criticism findings from Driscoll et al., 1972), both passages in the supplied text that state the full contrast (Results, p. 172, lines 180-184, interrupted mid-word by the left-column heading 'Commitment'; and Discussion/Implications, p. 176, lines 476-481, interleaved with the right column) are split across interleaved two-column text. Because interleaved-column reconstruction is prohibited and the intact contiguous fragment omits the opening negative clause needed to establish a self-contained 'mixed' verdict, the outcome must remain undeterminable.
